source: Which repository and ref each file in grammars/ is built from: build/main.ts and package-lock.json of microsoft/vscode-tree-sitter-wasm at v0.3.1. License texts are the LICENSE file of each repository at that ref. When the package version changes, re-derive this file; the build fails until it matches.
